operation.summary: How right the watch's cheap stages are, to tune it with: every stage that decides (the free change check, the sound match, the paid model, the paid cap) keeps a small record per reading on the phone (no photos or sound, 30 days, at most 20000). A sample of the readings the free stage answered is asked of the paid model anyway (audit_share, default 1 in 50, never below 1 in 200, paid and counted like any check), and this reports how often they disagreed
operation.returns: watch_id, label, task (the question the records are about), current {model, interval_s, local, max_paid_per_hour}, window_days, since, records, readings, settings {audit_share, audit_share_set, audit_share_default, audit_share_min, audit_share_max, keep_days, max_records}, stages [{stage: change_gate|sound_match|model|paid_cap|camera, service, count, decided, cost_usd, latency_ms_p50}], reuse {free_checks, answered_free, share}, audit {due, done, skipped, skipped_because, agreed, misses, miss_rate, miss_rate_interval_95 [low, high]}, calibration [{band (the reused answer's confidence), free_answers, audited, agreed, agreement}], health {no_photo, over_paid_cap, <model error>, dark_records}, by {camera, hour, light: {<key>: {decisions, audited, misses, miss_rate}}}, labels {sources, about}, notes [plain hints with their numbers]. A miss is an audit whose paid answer differed from the reused one; it can't show where the paid model itself is wrong. Change the watch with the routes you made it with
